label: Broker host
help: Explicit hostname or IP; empty leaves the block inactive. Never supplied by graph messages.

label: Broker port
help: TLS brokers commonly use 8883; set the actual configured port.

label: Use verified TLS
help: Certificate and hostname verification cannot be bypassed. Disable only for anonymous trusted local tests.

label: Wallet reference
help: Optional secret:// reference to JSON with username and password. Credentials require TLS.

label: Subscribed topic filters
help: Array of MQTT filters. + matches one level; # must be the final whole level. Maximum 16.

label: Allowed publish filters
help: An empty list disables publishing. Incoming requests cannot broaden this allowlist.

label: Payload format
help: Strict JSON or UTF-8 text. Binary audio is not transported here.

label: Additional CA file
help: Optional trusted PEM CA file, resolved relative to the application root.

label: MQTT QoS
help: QoS 0 sends without broker acknowledgement; QoS 1 can deliver duplicates. Not exactly-once business processing.

label: Allow retained messages
help: Allow retained reception and explicit retained publishing. Off by default.

label: Start a clean broker session
help: When disabled, configure a unique stable client ID. Broker retention does not persist this block’s outgoing queue.

label: Client ID
help: Optional for clean sessions; otherwise required. Never share one between concurrently running nodes.

label: Connection timeout (seconds)
help: Whole connection/subscription deadline, including DNS. Stop terminates the supervised helper.

label: Automatic reconnect attempts
help: Additional attempts after a failure. Explicit resume can restart a stopped connection.

label: Reconnect delay (seconds)
help: Wait between bounded attempts. No automatic replay of uncertain outgoing requests.

label: Payload limit (bytes)
help: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per payload. Oversized messages are refused.

label: Pending publish limit
help: Bounded outstanding requests. Disconnection reports uncertainty instead of retrying them.

label: Incoming rate limit
help: Disconnect visibly on overload instead of growing an unbounded application queue.
